question: What does error E-4471 mean?
relevant_keys: tickets/past-tickets.md#Ticket 3102 — scanner error E-4471 in warehouse 2
reference: The handheld scanner lost its session with the WMS server because the token expired; log out and in again, restart the cradle if it persists.

question: My scanner says E-5103, what do I do?
reference: The shipping-label printer queue is full; clear it in the label printer web console.

question: What should I do about error E-6001?
reference: SAP interface timeout: wait 5 minutes and retry; if it repeats open a high-priority ticket.

question: What is the minimum password length?
reference: 14 characters for standard accounts, 20 for privileged accounts.

question: How long does an account stay locked after too many failed logins?
reference: Standard accounts lock for 15 minutes after 10 failed attempts and unlock automatically.

question: Do I have to change my password every 90 days?
reference: No. Standard accounts rotate only after suspected compromise; privileged accounts every 180 days. The 90-day rule was a 2023 draft.

question: How do I reset my password myself?
reference: Use self-service reset at passwordreset.acme.internal if MFA is registered; otherwise the Service Desk sends a reset link after verifying identity.

question: Can my manager reset my password for me?
reference: Only if the line manager requests it and IT Security approves; otherwise resets on behalf of others are refused.

question: Which password manager is approved?
reference: Bitwarden Business.

question: How do I connect to the VPN from home?
reference: Open GlobalProtect, portal vpn.acme-logistics.de, sign in and approve MFA.

question: My VPN keeps dropping every few minutes
reference: Switch to 5 GHz Wi-Fi or cable and update GlobalProtect to 6.2+; report persistent drops with the client log.

question: Do I need the VPN for Teams?
reference: No; Microsoft 365 and Teams work without VPN. VPN is needed for SAP, WMS and file shares.

question: Can I work from Austria for two weeks?
reference: Yes, EU/EEA countries are allowed for up to 30 days per year with the VPN.

question: Can a contractor work from abroad on VPN?
reference: Contractors only get VPN access to listed systems during the contract; work abroad follows the EU/EEA 30-day rule, outside EU needs IT Security and HR approval.

question: Is split tunnelling enabled?
reference: Yes; only internal traffic uses the VPN. Exceptions need IT Security approval.

question: I got a new phone and MFA doesn't work anymore
reference: Register the new phone first; if the old one is gone the Service Desk resets MFA after a video identity check.

question: How do I set up the authenticator app?
reference: Install Microsoft Authenticator, go to aka.ms/mysecurityinfo, add the authenticator app and scan the QR code.

question: What do I do if I lose my FIDO2 key?
reference: Report the lost key within 24 hours.

question: I clicked on a phishing link, what now?
relevant_keys: it/security-incident.md#If you clicked a phishing link
reference: Disconnect from the network and call the IT Security hotline at extension 4400 immediately.

question: How quickly must a data breach be reported?
reference: To the DPO within 24 hours; the company must notify the authority within 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33).

question: How many vacation days does a full-time employee get?
reference: 30 days.

question: How many vacation days do working students get?
reference: 24 days.

question: Until when can I carry over unused leave?
reference: Until 31 March of the following year.

question: When do I need a doctor's note?
reference: From the fourth day of illness (eAU, transmitted electronically).

question: How many days off do I get when I move house?
reference: One day.

question: When must I request parental leave?
reference: In writing at least seven weeks before it starts.

question: Can I work part-time during Elternzeit?
reference: Yes, up to 32 hours per week, agreed with manager and HR two months ahead.

question: When are expense reports paid out?
reference: Reports approved by the 20th are paid with that month's salary.

question: What is the hotel limit for business trips?
reference: Up to 150 EUR per night in Germany.

question: A supplier invoice was paid twice, what should I do?
reference: Don't contact the bank; open a billing ticket with both references; Finance requests a credit note.

question: Where do suppliers send invoices?
reference: invoices@acme-logistics.de as PDF or XRechnung, with a PO number.

question: What are our standard payment terms?
reference: 30 days net.

question: How do I get access to the finance shared drive?
reference: Request it in the Service Portal; the Head of Finance must approve.

question: How long does an access request take?
reference: Two business days after approval.

question: How often are access rights reviewed?
reference: Quarterly by data owners.

question: My laptop shows a blue screen after an update
reference: Boot into Safe Mode, uninstall the latest quality update, restart; report the stop code.

question: Outlook crashes whenever I open a PDF attachment
reference: Start Outlook in safe mode and disable add-ins; the PDF preview add-in is the usual cause.

question: Which printers are on the second floor?
reference: PR-2A (colour, kitchen) and PR-2B (black and white, meeting rooms).

question: Are shared accounts allowed?
reference: No, except documented service accounts stored in the IT vault.

question: How do I report a suspicious email?
reference: Use the Report phishing button in Outlook.
